serverNotReady.where: Setlist import / matrix / update broadcast: Error toast/message when the server's database connection is not initialised (rare, transient).

importSucceeded.where: Setlist importer: success message after an imported setlist was created

noFileProvided.where: Setlist importer (document upload): error when no document was attached

fileTooLarge.where: Setlist importer (document upload): error when the document is too big
fileTooLarge.context: {maxMb} is a number of megabytes; 'MB' is the unit

unsupportedDocument.where: Setlist importer (document upload): error when the file type is not supported
unsupportedDocument.context: Keep the file extensions .docx, .pdf, .txt as written

noTextProvided.where: Setlist importer: error when the document produced no text to structure

missingUrlOrCsv.where: Setlist importer (spreadsheet): error when neither a sheet link nor pasted CSV was sent (developer error)
missingUrlOrCsv.context: 'url' and 'csvText' are technical field names; keep them as written

sheetFetchFailed.where: Setlist importer (spreadsheet): error when the Google Sheet link could not be read
sheetFetchFailed.context: "Anyone with the link can view" is Google's own sharing-setting label (use Google's Hebrew wording for it). {detail} is the technical error text, usually English

sheetFetchUnknownError.where: Setlist importer (spreadsheet): the detail shown inside the 'Could not retrieve spreadsheet data' error when no specific reason is known

spreadsheetEmpty.where: Setlist importer (spreadsheet): error when the sheet has no rows

spreadsheetTooLarge.where: Setlist importer (spreadsheet): error when the sheet has too many rows

geminiKeyMissing.where: Setlist importer (spreadsheet): error when the server's AI key is missing (configuration problem)
geminiKeyMissing.context: 'Gemini' is the AI service's brand name; keep it

broadcastLeadersOnly.where: Setlist editor: error when a non-leader triggers the 'setlist updated' notification to the band
